notes.title: PixelOver 0.18.1 alpha 1 - Animation Improvements
notes.content:
Hello! This is the first alpha release featuring major animation improvements. 
  This update introduces the new [b]global Rest/Pose mode[/b], a huge change in how PixelOver handles animations. 
  With this system, animations remain fully isolated from each other.

	
Please note that pre-release versions may be unstable.
    

    [h3][url=https://docs.pixelover.io/manual/installation_and_update/#access-to-pre-release-versions ]How to access pre-release versions[/url][/h3]
	


	[h3][url=https://pixelover.io/roadmap/ ]Roadmap and news[/url][/h3]
	[h3][url=https://docs.pixelover.io/ ]Documentation and tutorials[/url][/h3]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[table]
	
		[tr]
			[td]
				Rest/Pose is now a global system for all objects.

				- Changes in Rest Pose set the default value for all animations.

				- Changes in Pose Mode affect only the selected animation.

				[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282507/039fe0a6492da4c0e7e714d91c5580ba76b63a15.gif[/img]
			[/td]
		[/tr]
		[tr]
			[td]
				Added a parameter for drawing tools to keep the object on top while drawing.
			[/td]
		[/tr]
		[tr]
			[td]
				Added copy/paste support for shaders.
			[/td]
		[/tr]
		[tr]
			[td]
				Improved animation track synchronization with object selection.
			[/td]
		[/tr]
		[tr]
			[td]
				Improved the Add Track dialog with a tab system (particle properties are now separated from other properties).
			[/td]
		[/tr]
		[tr]
			[td]
				Added an option in settings to choose the default pixel-scaling algorithm.
			[/td]
		[/tr]
		[tr]
			[td]
				Added Escape key shortcut to deselect all tracks and keys.
			[/td]
		[/tr]
	
[/table]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[table]
	
		[tr]
			[td]Issue[/td]
			[td]Reference[/td]
		[/tr]
		[tr]
			[td]Fixed an issue with incorrectly exporting empty JSON files.[/td]
			[td][url=https://discord.com/channels/839896869852676127/839897610855645244/1415732134697762897 ]Link[/url][/td]
		[/tr]
		[tr]
			[td]Fixed incorrect drawing cursor position when an object has a custom offset.[/td]
			[td](Not reported)[/td]
		[/tr]
		[tr]
			[td]Fixed crashes when using multi-select.[/td]
			[td](Not reported)[/td]
		[/tr]
		[tr]
			[td]Fixed inputs sometimes appearing in the wrong order.[/td]
			[td](Not reported)[/td]
		[/tr]
		[tr]
			[td]Fixed tree losing selection on items.[/td]
			[td](Not reported)[/td]
		[/tr]
	
[/table]



If you encounter any bugs or have feature suggestions, feel free to share them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1762550/discussions/0/]community forum[/url]. Thank you!
